text_markup: A conditional ability is considered used once the relevant optional effects of the ability have been resolved by the controller of the ability. See {ref:sec_steps_of_triggering_and_resolving_a_conditional_ability} for the steps of triggering and resolving conditional abilities.
text_plain: A conditional ability is considered used once the relevant optional effects of the ability have been resolved by the controller of the ability. See step 9.6.15 for the steps of triggering and resolving conditional abilities.
